notes.title: ウクライナ語の追加！と新バージョン！のβ版
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719975/68a004d2926195217c9bc1a8a38dfe7bf838d2af.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719975/43de47452459f9f5ca6b450374c71bc18a25eedc.jpg[/img][/url]

みなさんこんばんは、作者です。

使用しているゲームエンジンをアプデしたら本作のプロジェクトが吹っ飛び、
それを新作作りながら修正すること数か月。

遂に、β版を出すことが出来ました。

ライブラリから本作を右クリックし、
β版を選択すると新しいβ版のDLが始まります。


まだ挙動は安定しないですが、
以前から有志が作ってくれていたウクライナ語の実装が出来ました。

まだランキング周りなどでバグがありますが、
お時間のある方は動作周りチェックしてくれると嬉しいです！


Hello everyone, it's the developer here.

After updating the game engine I use, the project for this game got blown away, and it took a few months to fix it while also working on a new project.

Finally, we've managed to release the beta version.

When you right-click on the game in the library, selecting the beta version will initiate the download of the new beta version.

Although the behavior is still not stable, we've managed to implement Ukrainian language support, which was being developed by volunteers.

There are still bugs, especially around the ranking system, but if you have some time, I'd appreciate it if you could check the functionality!

notes.title: Mary's dressing challenge！
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing Hazama Queen.

Actually, I am already working on my next project,
I started to think that I would like to have a girl with four legs or reverse-jointed legs as the main character.

So from now on, HZMQ will be mainly bug fixes,
But that's boring, too.

Reviews reached "very positive".

Sales exceed 1,000 units."

I'd like to show you Mary's outfit on the difficulty selection screen in the game,
I'm thinking of adapting Mary's outfit from the difficulty selection screen to the actual game screen!

It's a lot of work, so please let me do something with that kind of break!
So, while I write this review with a word of thanks to everyone, "It was good",
Let's promote this work to our friends and strangers and get Mary dressed!
